SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name, e.profile_embedding::text AS profile_embedding, e.profile_n, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as')) AS degree FROM entities e
WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{typeId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL
AND e.description IS NULL AND (lower(e.canonical_name) = ANY(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}) OR e.id IN (SELECT nf.subject_id FROM facts nf JOIN relation_types nr ON nr.id = nf.predicate_id WHERE nf.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as' AND nf.invalidated_at IS NULL AND nf.object_value IS NOT NULL AND lower(nf.object_value->>'value') = ANY(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler})))

SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name, t.key AS type_key, e.type_id, e.type_source, e.profile_embedding::text AS profile_embedding, e.profile_n FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.type_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{typeId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.description IS NULL AND (lower(e.canonical_name) = ANY(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}) OR e.id IN (SELECT nf.subject_id FROM facts nf JOIN relation_types nr ON nr.id = nf.predicate_id WHERE nf.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as' AND nf.invalidated_at IS NULL AND nf.object_value IS NOT NULL AND lower(nf.object_value->>'value') = ANY(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler})))
SELECT CASE WHEN left_id = #{entityId} THEN right_id ELSE left_id END FROM resolution_reviews WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'kept' AND (left_id = #{entityId} OR right_id = #{entityId})

SELECT s.subject_id, s.name FROM ( SELECT f.subject_id, o.canonical_name AS name, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY f.subject_id ORDER BY EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_ranges rr WHERE rr.relation_type_id = r.id) DESC, COALESCE(r.temporal = 'state', FALSE) DESC, COALESCE(r.functional, FALSE) DESC, f.confidence DESC, f.recorded_at DESC ) AS rn FROM facts f LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.subject_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facts g WHERE g.kb_id = #{kbId} AND g.subject_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND g.subject_id <> f.subject_id AND g.object_id = f.object_id AND g.invalidated_at IS NULL) ) s WHERE s.rn <= #{limit}
SELECT key FROM entity_types WHERE id = #{typeId}
SELECT label FROM entity_types WHERE id = #{typeId}

WITH RECURSIVE up_a(id) AS ( SELECT #{a}::uuid UNION SELECT p.parent_id FROM entity_type_parents p JOIN up_a ON p.child_id = up_a.id ), up_b(id) AS ( SELECT #{b}::uuid UNION SELECT p.parent_id FROM entity_type_parents p JOIN up_b ON p.child_id = up_b.id ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up_a WHERE id = #{b}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up_b WHERE id = #{a}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up_a JOIN up_b USING (id) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_type_parents p WHERE p.child_id = up_a.id))
mapper.update: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(#{kb}), hashtext(#{name}))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM entities WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND canonical_name = #{name} AND type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{typeId} AND merged_into IS NULL AND description IS NULL AND id <> ALL(#{weighed,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entities (id, kb_id, type_id, canonical_name, profile_embedding, profile_n) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{typeId}, #{name}, #{profile}::vector, #{profileN})
INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_value) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{entityId}, #{knownAs}, jsonb_build_object('value', #{name}::text))
INSERT INTO entities (id, kb_id, type_id, canonical_name, description, specific_type) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, NULL, #{description}, #{description}, left(#{kindWord}, 80))
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WITH before AS ( SELECT id, type_id, canonical_name FROM entities WHERE id = #{entityId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND merged_into IS NULL AND type_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{typeId} ) UPDATE entities e SET type_id = #{typeId}, updated_at = now(), type_source = CASE WHEN #{actor}::uuid IS NULL THEN 'inferred' ELSE 'human' END FROM before WHERE e.id = before.id RETURNING before.type_id AS from_type, before.canonical_name AS name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entity_retypes (batch_id, kb_id, entity_id, from_type_id, to_type_id, actor_id) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{kbId}, #{entityId}, #{fromTypeId}, #{toTypeId}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT profile_embedding::text FROM entities WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET profile_embedding = #{profile}::vector, profile_n = #{profileN}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM entities WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND merged_into IS NULL AND lower(canonical_name) = lower(#{name})
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET disambiguator = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.canonical_name FROM facts f LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.subject_id = #{id} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facts g WHERE g.kb_id = #{kbId} AND g.subject_id = ANY(#{peers,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND g.subject_id <> #{id} AND g.object_id = f.object_id AND g.invalidated_at IS NULL)) DESC, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_ranges rr WHERE rr.relation_type_id = r.id) DESC, COALESCE(r.temporal = 'state', FALSE) DESC, COALESCE(r.functional, FALSE) DESC, f.confidence DESC, f.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT t.label FROM entities e JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET disambiguator = #{value} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id FROM entities e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.description IS NULL AND (lower(e.canonical_name) = ANY(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}) OR e.id IN (SELECT nf.subject_id FROM facts nf JOIN relation_types nr ON nr.id = nf.predicate_id WHERE nf.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as' AND nf.invalidated_at IS NULL AND nf.object_value IS NOT NULL AND lower(nf.object_value->>'value') = ANY(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}))) ORDER BY (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as')) DESC, e.created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resolution_reviews AS existing (id, kb_id, left_id, right_id, score, reason, stage) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{leftId}, #{rightId}, #{score}, #{reason}, #{stage}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, least(left_id, right_id), greatest(left_id, right_id)) WHERE status = 'pending' DO UPDATE SET stage = 'human', reason = EXCLUDED.reason WHERE EXCLUDED.stage = 'human' AND existing.stage = 'adjudicating'
mapper.update: UPDATE resolution_reviews SET stage = 'human', reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE resolution_reviews SET status = #{status}, reason = #{reason}, decided_at = now() WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT id, left_id, right_id, score, reason, stage, created_at FROM resolution_reviews WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'pending' AND stage = 'adjudicating' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, left_id, right_id, score, reason, stage, created_at FROM resolution_reviews WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'pending'
SELECT same, confidence FROM resolution_verdicts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND pair_key = #{pairKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resolution_verdicts (kb_id, pair_key, same, confidence, model) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{pairKey}, #{same}, #{confidence}, #{model}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, pair_key) DO UPDATE SET same = #{same}, confidence = #{confidence}, model = #{model}, created_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT merged_into FROM entities WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId}
SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE kb_id = (SELECT kb_id FROM entities WHERE id = #{entityId}) AND (subject_id = #{entityId} OR object_id = #{entityId}) AND invalidated_at IS NULL
SELECT type_id, canonical_name, profile_embedding::text AS profile_embedding, profile_n, merged_into FROM entities WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (subject_id = #{sourceId} OR object_id = #{sourceId})

UPDATE facts SET invalidated_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND ((subject_id = #{sourceId} AND object_id = #{targetId}) OR (subject_id = #{targetId} AND object_id = #{sourceId})) RETURNING id
UPDATE facts SET subject_id = #{targetId} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND subject_id = #{sourceId} RETURNING id
UPDATE facts SET object_id = #{targetId} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND object_id = #{sourceId} RETURNING id

SELECT unnest((array_agg(id ORDER BY recorded_at))[2:]) FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND (subject_id = #{targetId} OR object_id = #{targetId}) GROUP BY subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, object_value, valid_from HAVING count(*) > 1
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET invalidated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
UPDATE entities SET profile_embedding = #{profile}::vector, profile_n = #{profileN}, type_id = #{typeId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{targetId}
UPDATE entities SET merged_into = #{targetId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId}

UPDATE resolution_reviews AS r SET status = 'kept', reason = 'superseded by merge', decided_at = now() WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.status = 'pending' AND (r.left_id = #{sourceId} OR r.right_id = #{sourceId}) AND NOT (least(r.left_id, r.right_id) = least(#{sourceId}, #{targetId}) AND greatest(r.left_id, r.right_id) = greatest(#{sourceId}, #{targetId})) AND ( (CASE WHEN r.left_id = #{sourceId} THEN r.right_id ELSE r.left_id END) = #{targetId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM resolution_reviews d WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.status = 'pending' AND d.id <> r.id AND least(d.left_id, d.right_id) = least(#{targetId}, CASE WHEN r.left_id = #{sourceId} THEN r.right_id ELSE r.left_id END) AND greatest(d.left_id, d.right_id) = greatest(#{targetId}, CASE WHEN r.left_id = #{sourceId} THEN r.right_id ELSE r.left_id END)) )

UPDATE resolution_reviews SET left_id = CASE WHEN left_id = #{sourceId} THEN #{targetId} ELSE left_id END, right_id = CASE WHEN right_id = #{sourceId} THEN #{targetId} ELSE right_id END, reason = reason || '|redirected' WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'pending' AND (left_id = #{sourceId} OR right_id = #{sourceId}) AND NOT (least(left_id, right_id) = least(#{sourceId}, #{targetId}) AND greatest(left_id, right_id) = greatest(#{sourceId}, #{targetId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entity_merges (id, kb_id, source_id, target_id, moved_subject_facts, moved_object_facts, invalidated_facts, target_profile_before, target_profile_n_before, target_type_before, merged_by, reason) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{sourceId}, #{targetId}, #{movedSubject,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}, #{movedObject,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}, #{invalidated,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}, #{profileBefore}::vector, #{profileNBefore}, #{typeBefore}, #{mergedBy}, #{reason})
mapper.update: UPDATE entity_merges SET temporal_corrections = #{corrections,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT source_id, target_id, moved_subject_facts, moved_object_facts, invalidated_facts, target_profile_before::text AS target_profile_before, target_profile_n_before, target_type_before, reverted_at FROM entity_merges WHERE id = #{mergeId} AND kb_id = #{kbId}
WITH RECURSIVE chain(id) AS ( SELECT #{targetId}::uuid UNION SELECT e.merged_into FROM entities e JOIN chain ON e.id = chain.id WHERE e.merged_into IS NOT NULL) SELECT id FROM chain

WITH RECURSIVE chain(id) AS ( SELECT unnest(#{roots,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) UNION SELECT f.id FROM facts f JOIN chain c ON f.supersedes = c.id ) SELECT id FROM chain
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET subject_id = #{sourceId} WHERE id = ANY(#{movedSubject,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND subject_id = ANY(#{holders,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})

UPDATE facts SET object_id = #{sourceId} WHERE id = ANY(#{movedObject,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND object_id = ANY(#{holders,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM facts WHERE id = ANY(#{rows,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND id <> ALL(#{ledger,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND subject_id = ANY(#{holders,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})

SELECT id FROM facts WHERE id = ANY(#{rows,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND id <> ALL(#{ledger,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND object_id = ANY(#{holders,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET invalidated_at = NULL WHERE id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
UPDATE entities SET profile_embedding = #{profile}::vector, profile_n = #{profileN}, type_id = coalesce(#{typeId}, type_id), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{targetId}
UPDATE entities SET merged_into = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId}
UPDATE entity_merges SET reverted_at = now() WHERE id = #{mergeId}
UPDATE entities SET specific_type = left(#{value}, 80) WHERE id = #{entityId} AND specific_type IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name, ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT nf.object_value->>'value' FROM facts nf JOIN relation_types nr ON nr.id = nf.predicate_id WHERE nf.subject_id = e.id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as' AND nf.invalidated_at IS NULL AND lower(nf.object_value->>'value') <> lower(e.canonical_name)) AS other_names, t.key AS coarse_key, t.id AS coarse_id, t.description AS coarse_description, e.proposed_type, e.specific_type, ARRAY( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(rt.key, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) || CASE WHEN f.subject_id = e.id THEN ' ' ELSE ' by ' END || coalesce(oe.canonical_name, 'a value') FROM facts f LEFT JOIN relation_types rt ON rt.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities oe ON oe.id = CASE WHEN f.subject_id = e.id THEN f.object_id ELSE f.subject_id END WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id) AND COALESCE(rt.key, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) IS NOT NULL AND NOT coalesce(rt.builtin AND rt.key = 'known_as', false) LIMIT 12 ) AS roles, ARRAY( SELECT DISTINCT ev.quote FROM fact_evidence ev JOIN facts f2 ON f2.id = ev.fact_id LEFT JOIN relation_types rt2 ON rt2.id = f2.predicate_id WHERE f2.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f2.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f2.subject_id = e.id AND ev.quote IS NOT NULL AND NOT coalesce(rt2.builtin AND rt2.key = 'known_as', false) LIMIT 3 ) AS quotes, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f3 LEFT JOIN relation_types rt3 ON rt3.id = f3.predicate_id WHERE f3.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f3.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (f3.subject_id = e.id OR f3.object_id = e.id) AND NOT coalesce(rt3.builtin AND rt3.key = 'known_as', false)) AS fact_count FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.type_source <> 'human' AND (e.type_id IS NULL OR e.proposed_type IS NOT NULL OR e.specific_type IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_type_parents p WHERE p.parent_id = t.id)) AND (NOT #{unattended}::bool OR e.type_resolved_at IS NULL) ORDER BY fact_count DESC, e.created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET type_resolved_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT profile_embedding::text FROM entities WHERE id = #{entityId} AND kb_id = #{kbId}
